subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: The Future of Supply Chains
description: A quick, practical guide to The Future of Supply Chains.

hook.text: A drone delivers medicine to a remote village. An AI reroutes a fleet around a storm. The future is here.

buildup.text: Supply chains are becoming digital, autonomous, and data-driven at an accelerating pace.

discovery.text: AI predicts demand, IoT tracks shipments in real time, and robots pick orders in dark warehouses.

twist.text: Technology alone doesn't fix a broken chain. Strategy, people, and trust still hold it together.

climax.text: The future supply chain is resilient, visible, sustainable, and fast. Getting there is the hard part.

punchline.text: Technology enables. People and strategy deliver.

quiz.question: What still holds supply chains together beyond technology?
